title: Control caches theme property values too long
body:
### Tested versions

Tested and reproduced in:
- 4.6.3
- 4.0.4
- 4.7-rc2

### System information

`Godot v4.6.3.stable (35e80b3a8) - CachyOS Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 13 Jun 2026 11:49:00 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti (nvidia; 610.43.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.53 GiB memory`

### Issue description

It appears that theme properties persist in some way in code after calling certain get functions in `_ready()`. Visually, the properties are updated, but functions such as `Theme.get_color()` will return the value they returned when they were called from `_ready()`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create and save a theme, `custom_theme.tres`
2. Override a property in custom_theme
3. Apply custom_theme to control
4. From the script of one of the controls using that theme, call `get_theme_color` or similar from `_ready`
5. Later, set that theme property to a new value then call the same function to get the theme property from the same script.

Expected result:
Theme property get method returns the updated color.

Actual result:
Theme property get method returns the value it had when it was called from `_ready` once, subsequent calls returns the correct value.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

`mrp.tscn` is the minimal reproduction.
I tested some more cases in `more_testing/more_testing.tscn` to show that the issue is consistent.

[theme-property-value-persistence.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29064147/theme-property-value-persistence.zip)
